arrowOffset.description: Sets the arrow's left position, in pixels from the tooltip's left edge, instead of letting it be calculated. Values past the tooltip's width move the arrow out of sight.

componentSlot.description: Content below the text, with 12px above it when there is text. The place for anything that is not a string, including TooltipTable.

hasInvertedStyle.description: True is the dark tooltip: a black surface with white semibold text. False is the light one, with a hairline outline and body text.

textAlign.description: Overrides the alignment the width would pick.

title.description: Tooltip title. Zero-length titles string, undefined, null and false are never displayed.

width.description: Caps the tooltip at 250px or 550px. Wide also left-aligns the text. It logs a warning about being light-only whichever style it is used with.
